q1.explanationZh: coach 名词“长途汽车；教练”，动词“训练；指导”。

q3.explanationZh: coast“海岸”，on the coast“在沿海”。注意和 coat 区分，多一个 s。

q4.explanationZh: coat 名词“外套；层”，动词“在……上涂”。

q6.explanationZh: code 名词“密码；代码”，动词“编码”，break the code“破解密码”。

q7.explanationZh: coffee“咖啡”，注意 ff 和 ee 都是双写。

q8.explanationZh: coin 名词“硬币”，动词“铸币；创造（新词）”。

q9.explanationZh: coincidence“巧合”，It is no coincidence that...“……并非巧合”。

q10.explanationZh: Coke 是商标名“可口可乐”（= Coca-Cola），通常大写。

q11.explanationZh: cold 形容词“冷的”，名词“感冒”，catch a cold“感冒”。

q12.explanationZh: collaborate“合作”，collaborate with sb.“与某人合作”，注意双写 l。

q13.explanationZh: collapse 不及物动词“倒塌；崩溃”，注意双写 l。

q15.explanationZh: colleague“同事”，注意结尾是 -league。书末答案原印 colleage，为拼写错误，经人工复核更正为 colleague（GitHub #136）。

q16.explanationZh: collect“收集；聚集”，指有选择地搜集、逐渐积累。

q17.explanationZh: collect 加 -ion 构成名词 collection“收集；收藏品”。

q18.explanationZh: college“大学；学院”，go to college“上大学”。

q20.explanationZh: 英式拼写 colour，美式拼写 color，名词“颜色”，动词“给……着色”。

q21.explanationZh: column“柱；专栏”，结尾的 n 不发音，别漏写。

q22.explanationZh: comb 名词“梳子”，动词“梳理”，结尾的 b 不发音。

q23.explanationZh: combine 的名词形式 combination“结合；混合体”，去掉 e 加 -ation。

q24.explanationZh: combine“（使）结合”，combine A with B“把 A 和 B 结合起来”。

q25.explanationZh: come 不及物动词“来”，过去式 came，过去分词 come。

q26.explanationZh: comedy“喜剧”加 -ian 表示人：comedian“喜剧演员”。

q28.explanationZh: comfort 动词“安慰”，名词“舒适；安慰”，形容词是 comfortable。

q29.explanationZh: comfort 加 -able 构成形容词 comfortable“舒适的”，反义词 uncomfortable。

q30.explanationZh: comic 形容词“喜剧的；漫画的”，名词“喜剧演员；连环漫画”。

q31.explanationZh: command 名词、动词同形，“命令；指挥；掌握”，注意双写 m。

q32.explanationZh: command 加 -er 表示人：commander“指挥官”。

q33.explanationZh: 美式英语“邮政编码”是 Zip Code / zip code，英式英语用 postcode。

q34.explanationZh: “法国殖民地”= French colony，French 表示“法国的”。

q35.explanationZh: combine A with B“把 A 和 B 结合起来”，介词用 with。

q36.explanationZh: come across“偶然遇见；不期而遇”。

q37.explanationZh: come down with“患上（某种病）”，如 come down with a cold。

q38.explanationZh: come into existence / being“产生，形成”。

q40.explanationZh: come to“达到；共计；苏醒”，表示“苏醒”时也可说 come to oneself。

q41.explanationZh: come to power / come into power“上台执政”。

accept: come to / arrive at a conclusion

q42.explanationZh: “得出结论”= come to a conclusion，也可说 arrive at a conclusion。

q43.explanationZh: come up with“想出（主意、办法等）”。

q44.explanationZh: come up“走近”，走近某人说 come up to sb.。

q45.explanationZh: come on“快点；走吧”，常用来催促或鼓励别人。

q46.explanationZh: comic 形容词“喜剧的”，a comic actor“喜剧演员”。

q47.explanationZh: “成百上千幢大楼在地震中倒塌”，collapse“倒塌”，地震已经发生，用过去式 collapsed。

q48.explanationZh: a good command of...“精通……；很好地掌握……”，command 作名词。

q49.explanationZh: a 和 of 之间要用名词，a combination of...“……的结合”，即“各种情况的偶然结合”。

q50.explanationZh: 信息“被收集”，were 后接过去分词 collected 构成被动语态（主语 Huge amounts of information 为复数）。原书印 was，经人工复核更正为 were（GitHub #136）。

q51.explanationZh: It was no coincidence that...“……绝非巧合”。

q52.explanationZh: “祈使句 + and + 句子”结构，句首用动词原形；combine A with B“把 A 和 B 结合起来”，句首大写。

q53.explanationZh: come across“偶然发现”，讲过去的事用过去式 came。

q54.explanationZh: Spring College Entrance Examination“春季高考”，专有名称中首字母大写。

q55.explanationZh: come true“实现”，will 后接动词原形 come。

q56.explanationZh: devote...to doing sth. 中 to 是介词，后接动名词 collecting。

q57.explanationZh: 报纸开辟“专栏”讨论失业问题，a special column“一个专栏”。

q58.sampleAnswer: This drink, which is a combination of fruit and vegetable juices, tastes great.
references: This drink, which is a combination of fruit and vegetable juices, tastes great.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: “由……混合而成”= a combination of...；可用 which 引导非限制性定语从句补充说明饮料。

q59.sampleAnswer: When he came to himself, he found himself lying in bed.
references: When he came to himself, he found himself lying in bed.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “苏醒”= come to oneself，主语是 he，所以用 came to himself；find oneself doing“发现自己处于某状态”。

q60.sampleAnswer: Is this the best excuse (that) you can come up with?
references: Is this the best excuse (that) you can come up with?

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “想出”= come up with；the best excuse 后接省略 that 的定语从句。

q61.sampleAnswer: When it comes to creating a learning atmosphere, cultivating the team spirit, interacting with students, traditional teaching really has certain advantages over online teaching.
references: When it comes to creating a learning atmosphere, cultivating the team spirit, interacting with students, traditional teaching really has certain advantages over online teaching.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “谈及……”= when it comes to...，to 是介词，后接动名词 creating 等；“比……有优势”= have advantages over...。

q62.sampleAnswer: She combines the rich traditions of Chinese culture with the composition and performance techniques of Western classical music, giving new life and expressive power to music.
references: She combines the rich traditions of Chinese culture with the composition and performance techniques of Western classical music, giving new life and expressive power to music.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “把 A 与 B 融为一体”= combine A with B；“赋予……”用现在分词 giving 作结果状语。

q63.sampleAnswer: I am always grateful to those who comfort me when I am in low spirits.
references: I am always grateful to those who comfort me when I am in low spirits.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “安慰”= comfort；“对……心存感激”= be grateful to sb.；“失意”= in low spirits。

q64.sampleAnswer: Comedian is a person whose job is to make people laugh by telling jokes and amusing stories.
references: Comedian is a person whose job is to make people laugh by telling jokes and amusing stories.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “喜剧演员”= comedian；whose 引导定语从句；“通过……”= by doing。

q65.sampleAnswer: The room is filled with antiques collected by the owner from all over the world.
references: The room is filled with antiques collected by the owner from all over the world.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “堆满”= be filled with；古董“被收集”，用过去分词 collected 作后置定语。

q66.sampleAnswer: We can’t speak English fluently unless we command a large vocabulary.
references: We can’t speak English fluently unless we command a large vocabulary.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “掌握”= command（动词）；“只有……才……”可用 can’t...unless... 表达。

q67.sampleAnswer: Up to now, historians have assumed that calendars came into being with the introduction of agriculture.
references: Up to now, historians have assumed that calendars came into being with the introduction of agriculture.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “产生”= come into being；“至今”= up to now，主句用现在完成时；“随着……”= with...。
